translation: The tulsi-kyaro of the family members of the descendants of Navi Jithardi is in the field of Bhagat Vitthal Bhagwan of Kasampur. That field came to him from Khushal Swami. Khushal Swami's son, Bhagwan Swami, was the last in that line; he passed away around Samvat 2060. At present there is no one at Kasampur. Bhagwan Swami had only a daughter; he passed away at her home in Ganpatpura. Thus this Kasampur is a sacred site. It was to the village of Or that devotees had invited Jivanji; this Or is the very same place as Kasampur.
